title: MyAnimeList Analysis
description: Analyzed anime trends and viewer ratings from MyAnimeList data, focusing on isekai genre popularity over time. Built with Python and Pandas, with visualizations highlighting what makes a highly-rated isekai stand out.

title: Personal Finance Tracker
description: A personal finance dashboard built with Python and Streamlit for tracking expenses over time. Features interactive charts to visualize spending habits.

title: League of Legends Win Predictor
description: A machine learning project that predicts match outcomes using early and mid game states. Built with Python and scikit-learn featuring a Random Forest classifier trained on thousands of ranked games.

title: Twitch Dataset Analysis
description: Explored a large Twitch dataset using SQL for querying and Python for analysis to uncover trends in streamer growth, viewer behavior, and game popularity.

title: Online Shopping Website
description: A fully functional e-commerce desktop application built with Java and a GUI framework, featuring product browsing, a shopping cart, and checkout flow.

title: Interactive Visualization; Sea Surface Temperatures
description: An interactive D3.js visualization exploring sea surface temperature data over time. Users can explore trends along the west coast and anomalies through dynamic charts and maps.

title: Weather App
description: A responsive weather app that fetches real-time data from a public API and displays current conditions and forecasts. Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: To-do List App
description: A to-do list app built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Persuasive/Deceptive visualization
description: A paired visualization project exploring how design choices can make the same data appear to tell opposite stories.

title: Flappy Bird Game
description: A browser-based recreation of the classic Flappy Bird game built with HTML5 Canvas and JavaScript.

title: DSC106 Final Project
description: A data-driven storytelling project visualizing storm and weather futures using real climate datasets. Built with D3 featuring scrollytelling and interactive charts.
